description: Can I afford $X/month? Recomputes the user's Safe Monthly Draw (how much they can safely pay themselves) with an added recurring monthly cost, and returns a yes/tight/no verdict plus the before/after numbers. Use for questions like 'can I afford a $500/mo hire' or 'what if I add a $200/mo software subscription'. Requires at least 3 months of income history — otherwise returns insufficient_data rather than a guess.

deltaMonthly.description: The new recurring monthly cost being considered, in the user's home currency

name: whatif_afford

data.description: The full what-if scenario: assumptions, evidence, and computed outcome.

message.description: Scenario narrative; may be absent if the scenario carried no template or evidence.
